title: Travel Itinerary Day Planner
description: Plan a multi-day trip hour by hour: add days, drop in timed activities, reorder freely — auto-saved in your browser with a printable itinerary.
howto: Press Add day to create Day 1, Day 2, and so on.
Inside a day, add activities with a start time and description.
Remove any activity or whole day you no longer need — everything auto-saves.
Press Print itinerary for a clean paper copy of the whole trip.

faqs.a: In your browser's localStorage, namespaced to this tool. It persists across reloads on the same browser and device.
Yes — each activity has a time field (HH:MM) and a free-text description for what, where and notes.

faqs.q: How do I share the itinerary?
faqs.a: Use Copy as text to get a plain-text version for messaging apps, or Print for paper/PDF.
